open-datum VERSION (commit unknown)

Usage: open-datum COMMAND

Keep payloads under keys in a registry on Cardano: create the registry,
insert, update and terminate keys, fold the pending requests, and read a key
back.

Available settings:
  Show this help text
  switch: -h|--help

  Output version information: VERSION
  switch: --version

All commands:
  open-datum create                Boot a registry, or preview its identity
  open-datum insert                Book a new key with its payload
  open-datum update                Replace the payload of a key
  open-datum terminate             Book the termination of a key
  open-datum fold                  Fold the pending requests into the registry
  open-datum inspect               Read a key back, with its payload
  open-datum state create          Create a registry
  open-datum state fold            Fold the registrations and terminations you name
  open-datum registration book     Book the registration of a key
  open-datum registration reclaim  Take back a registration you booked
  open-datum registration cleanup  Clean up an expired registration
  open-datum holding update        Replace the payload of a live holding
  open-datum holding terminate     Book permanent termination of a live holding

Help on one command: open-datum COMMAND --help
Shell completion (bash): source <(open-datum --bash-completion-script "$(which open-datum)")
  zsh and fish: --zsh-completion-script and --fish-completion-script instead.

Every command takes --trace, --trace-to and --trace-format to narrate
what it does; standard output carries the receipt alone.
